title: BuiltinMediaGenerationV1
description: FEAT-172 application-owned MCP image generation. Existing Runtime, provider and Artifact lifecycle; no public media service or generation job database.

x-mcp.description: 易界内置图片生成 / Seedream image generation. For conversations with no selected expert, generate one image explicitly requested by the user, optionally using their single current-turn reference. A selected expert never falls back to this tool, including unavailable, failed, unsupported or unknown outcomes. Do not generate for image analysis. A blocked/unknown result does not authorize retry or a different provider. Images use the desktop Artifact viewer; staged is not yet committed. Discover this tool through native tool search; do not use an image CLI or ask for provider keys.

x-private-http.authentication: Dedicated Host-owned media bridge bearer, never the Runtime MCP token

x-authority.identity: Gateway reads threadId and x-codex-turn-metadata.turn_id from native MCP metadata. Host validates its owned root operation and waits only for that prepared turn to receive the authoritative Runtime binding; timeout, cancellation or a different binding never dispatches a provider.
x-authority.idempotency: One builtin attempt per accepted root turn; route rejection does not reserve; identical input reuses the receipt, different input after reservation conflicts; unknown never permits automatic resubmission.
x-authority.delivery: Reuse Artifact store and Native commit ACK; use existing get_artifact_status, no new generation state service.
x-authority.credentials: Operator-provisioned application credential; non-interactive lookup, never model or end-user supplied.
x-authority.runtime: Existing fixed Runtime; yijie_host_images=false and features.image_generation=false. No dynamic image tool or host image reverse producer.
x-authority.selection: An explicitly selected expert excludes builtin generation. Unavailable resources, credentials, tools, unsupported input, failure and unknown outcomes preserve that selection and report status; only an explicit user change/removal of the expert can change routing.
x-authority.terminal: A terminal notification or delayed interruption can close only its matching image turn, using native persisted identity if binding is still pending. A published success is immutable: a later cancellation must not replace that receipt or publish a second terminal.
